AS inspectItemId, ii.name AS inspectItemName, t.inspect_item_code AS inspectItemCode, t.item_config_id AS itemConfigId, t.parameter_id AS parameterId, ip.name AS parameterName, t.parameter_code AS parameterCode, t.parameter_config_id AS parameterConfigId, t.record_id AS recordId, t.record_version_id AS recordVersionId, br.name AS recordName, br.code AS recordCode, brv.version AS recordVersionNo, COALESCE(isp.standard_rule, sssp.standard_rule) AS standardRule, t.is_executable AS isExecutable, t.is_reportable AS isReportable, t.execute_method AS executeMethod, t.status, t.judged_abnormal AS abnormal, t.judged_result AS judgedResult, t.judged_time AS judgedTime, t.test_time AS testTime, t.owner_id AS ownerId, t.owner_name AS ownerName, le.entry_time AS entryTime, t.reviewed_by AS reviewedBy, t.reviewed_time AS reviewedTime, t.reviewed_abnormal_reason AS reviewRejectReason, io.order_no AS orderNo, m.name AS materialName, m.code AS materialCode, m.specification AS materialSpec, io.batch_no AS batchNo, io.create_time AS requestTime, io.create_by AS requestUserId, t.assigner_id AS assignerId, t.assigner_name AS assignerName, t.assign_time AS assignTime, t.claim_time AS claimTime, t.complete_time AS completeTime, t.terminate_time AS terminateTime, t.terminate_reason AS terminateReason, t.return_reason AS returnReason, t.reject_reason AS rejectReason, t.remark AS remark FROM lm_task t LEFT JOIN lm_inspection_order io ON io.id = t.inspection_order_id LEFT JOIN lm_inspect_material m ON io.material_id = m.id LEFT JOIN lm_inspection_scheme_version sv ON sv.id = io.scheme_version_id AND sv.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN lm_stability_scheme_version ssv ON ssv.id = io.scheme_version_id AND ssv.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN lm_inspect_item ii ON t.inspect_item_id = ii.id INNER JOIN lm_inspect_parameter ip ON t.parameter_id = ip.id LEFT JOIN lm_inspection_scheme_parameter isp ON isp.id = t.parameter_config_id AND isp.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN lm_stability_scheme_parameter sssp ON sssp.id = t.parameter_config_id AND sssp.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN bm_batch_record br ON br.id = t.record_id AND br.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN bm_batch_record_version brv ON brv.id = t.record_version_id AND brv.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ier.task_id, MAX(COALESCE(ier.update_time, ier.create_time)) AS entry_time FROM lm_inspection_entry_record ier WHERE ier.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY ier.task_id ) le ON le.task_id = t.id WHERE t.inspection_order_id = #{inspectionOrderId} AND t.is_deleted = 0
AND t.execute_method = #{query.executeMethod}
AND t.status = 'TO_REVIEW'
AND t.status NOT IN ('PENDING_ASSIGNMENT','RETURN_PENDING_APPROVAL')
AND t.owner_id = #{query.currentUserId}
AND t.parameter_id = #{query.parameterId}
AND ii.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.inspectItemName}, '%')
AND ip.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.parameterName}, '%')
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lm_inspection_order io WHERE io.id = t.inspection_order_id AND io.is_deleted = 0 AND io.material_id IN #{mid} )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lm_inspection_order io2 WHERE io2.id = t.inspection_order_id AND io2.is_deleted = 0 AND io2.create_time >= #{query.requestStartTime} )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lm_inspection_order io3 WHERE io3.id = t.inspection_order_id AND io3.is_deleted = 0 AND io3.create_time <= #{query.requestEndTime} )
AND t.status IN
#{st}
AND ((t.judged_abnormal = 1 AND t.status != 'TERMINATED') OR t.status IN ('REVIEW_REJECTED','SAMPLE_AUDIT_REJECTED'))
AND t.judged_abnormal = 0
ORDER BY t.inspect_item_code ASC, t.parameter_code ASC
